votes.motion: Issue an Order of Conditions to David Osoff for the addition within the buffer zone at 46 fire road 12, with three special conditions (erosion protection at base of driveway, stockpile areas shown on plan, project schedule before construction).
votes.quote: kj moved to isse an order of conditiuons with the special conditions: 1. erosion protection would be added at the base of the driveway.

votes.motion: Continue the Hickory Hills Association Notice of Intent (drawdown management plan) to the November 7 meeting to allow MM and the landowners to plan for sampling.
votes.quote: bp moved to continued to the november 7 meeting to allow for mm and the landowners to plan for sampling, kj seconded and the commission voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Approve an Order of Conditions for Michael Gormley's shoreline restoration at 611 Reservoir Road, with the condition that the sandy area be sloped back toward the yard and toward the lake.
votes.quote: a motion ot approve an order of conditions with the conditions the sandy area be sloped back towards the yard towards the lake was made by cl and seconded by kj.

votes.motion: Approve the expenditure for Commissioner Carl Luck to attend the MMA meeting, with the Conservation Commission paying half and the Sewer Commission paying half.
votes.quote: kj moved to approve the expenditure. cc seconded and the commission voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Pursue grant money from DCR for Hollis Hills under the forest stewardship and bird habitat planting program.
votes.quote: rb moved to pursue. kj seconded and the commission voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Issue Certificates of Compliance for 380 Sunset, 950 Chase Road, and Vivano 338 Sunset Lane (Mr. Luck recused from 338 Sunset Lane).
votes.quote: certificates issued by commission with a motion of kj and a second by cc with unanimous votes.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of August 15, 2018, September 5, 2018, September 19, 2018 and October 3, 2018 as amended.
votes.quote: all minutes were approved as amended by a motion of rb and a second of kj with a unanimous vote.
the meeting adjourned at 10:20 pm by a motion of kj and a second by cc with a unanimous roll call vote.
